cases.text:
Dear Noor,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Priya and I'm writing from Bangalore. My husband and I visited a tea estate in Munnar last year and loved it so much that we promised ourselves we would see a coffee farm on our next big trip, and a friend who stayed in Moshi in 2024 told us your tour was the highlight of her whole holiday.

We land at Kilimanjaro airport on the 19th, spend a few days on safari, and fly home on the 25th. My parents are travelling with us; they are both in their seventies and walk slowly, so a morning visit before it gets hot would suit them best. We would also love to buy some beans to take home, if that's possible.

So, to put it simply: could the four of us (my parents, my husband and I) visit on Thursday 22 October, in the morning?

With warm regards,
Priya

got.translation_for_noor:
Mpendwa Noor,

Natumai ujumbe huu utakukuta ukiwa mzima. Jina langu ni Priya na ninakuandikia kutoka Bangalore. Mume wangu na mimi tulitembelea shamba la chai huko Munnar mwaka jana na tulilipenda sana hadi tukajiapia kwamba tungeliona shamba la kahawa katika safari yetu kubwa inayofuata, na rafiki yangu ambaye alikaa Moshi mwaka 2024 alituambia kwamba ziara yenu ilikuwa kivutio kikubwa zaidi cha likizo yake yote.

Tunatua katika uwanja wa ndege wa Kilimanjaro tarehe 19, tutatumia siku chache kwenye safari, na tutaruka kurudi nyumbani tarehe 25. Wazazi wangu wanasafiri pamoja nasi; wote wako katika miaka ya sabini na hutembea polepole, kwa hiyo ziara ya asubuhi kabla ya joto kuwa kali ingewafaa zaidi. Pia tungependa sana kununua maharagwe ya kahawa ili tuyachukue nyumbani, kama hilo linawezekana.

Hivyo, kuiweka kwa urahisi: je, sisi watu wanne (wazazi wangu, mume wangu na mimi) tunaweza kutembelea Alhamisi tarehe 22 Oktoba, asubuhi?

Kwa salamu za upendo,
Priya

cases.note: Distracting dates (19th, 25th, 2024) and numbers; the request is in the last paragraph.
